description: This file defines a helper class 'BlazorComponent' that extends 'ComponentBase' to facilitate refresh behavior in Blazor components. It subscribes to a refresh event and triggers UI updates accordingly.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A base class for Blazor components that need to respond to refresh events via a singleton broadcast instance.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to the RefreshRequested event.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Method to trigger a refresh request via the broadcast instance.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler that updates the component state when a refresh is requested.
